theRealDefectFound.symptom: the ENTIRE PDF is blank — zero characters, one page
theRealDefectFound.diagnosis: These decks build print output into a #print-area div. That div IS populated (15,819 characters of innerHTML measured on PEQ_W3, present before any beforeprint event) and computes display:block under print media. Its children do not: every .print-section inside it computes to display:none under print. The print stylesheet turns #print-area on but never turns .print-section back on.
ruledOut: JS population — #print-area is already full before beforeprint fires, and dispatching beforeprint changes nothing
hidden ancestor — #print-area is a direct child of body, display:block, visibility:visible
theRealDefectFound.likelyFix: a single print rule per deck, e.g. @media print{.print-section{display:block}} — ONE LINE, but it is a CSS addition, not a placement move
theRealDefectFound.whyNotAppliedThisRun: §1.2 permits PLACEMENT ONLY inside .print-pack. A CSS rule addition is a different class of change, and 79 files exceeds the run ceiling. Proposed, not applied.
theRealDefectFound.severity: Higher than the original finding. These decks print nothing at all — not merely a missing signature line.
